n-i-p cell, PTAA HTL, PCBM ETL, MAPbI3 perovskite 500 nm, ETL of 30 nm, annealed at 100 C for 10 min

args.query: WITH nip AS (SELECT CAST(JV_default_PCE AS REAL) AS pce FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture = 'nip'), f AS (SELECT pce FROM nip WHERE pce IS NOT NULL AND pce > 0 AND pce < 40), fr AS (SELECT pce, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pce) rn, COUNT(*) OVER () cnt FROM f), rr AS (SELECT pce, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pce) rn, COUNT(*) OVER () cnt FROM nip WHERE pce IS NOT NULL) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nip) AS n_devices, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Ref_DOI_number) FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture = 'nip') AS n_papers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nip WHERE pce IS NULL) AS n_pce_null, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f) AS n_pce_valid, (SELECT MAX(pce) FROM nip) AS pce_max_raw, (SELECT MIN(pce) FROM nip) AS pce_min_raw, (SELECT AVG(pce) FROM nip) AS pce_mean_raw, (SELECT AVG(pce) FROM rr WHERE rn IN ((cnt+1)/2,(cnt+2)/2)) AS pce_median_raw, (SELECT AVG(pce) FROM f) AS pce_mean_valid, (SELECT AVG(pce) FROM fr WHERE rn IN ((cnt+1)/2,(cnt+2)/2)) AS pce_median_valid, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Ref_DOI_number) FROM devices WHERE Cell_architecture = 'nip' AND CAST(JV_default_PCE AS REAL) > 0) AS papers_with_valid_pce
